intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat with your partner as the sun dips below the Indian Ocean horizon. Enjoy chilled champagne, fresh tropical fruit platters, and breathtaking 360-degree ocean views. Many resorts offer this as a private romantic excursion perfect for honeymooners seeking an intimate and unforgettable sunset experience.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore some of the world's most vibrant coral reefs teeming with sea turtles, manta rays, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish. A guided snorkeling safari takes you to multiple pristine reef sites across the atoll, with equipment provided and a marine biologist on hand to narrate the underwater wonders. Ideal for couples who love the ocean.

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience
experiences.description: Dine in an extraordinary all-glass underwater restaurant surrounded by the living reef and marine life. Enjoy a curated multi-course fine dining menu featuring fresh Maldivian seafood and international cuisine while fish, rays, and eels glide past your table. A once-in-a-lifetime romantic dinner that epitomizes Maldivian luxury.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll (Hilton Conrad Maldives area)

experiences.name: Overwater Bungalow Couples Spa Ritual
experiences.description: Indulge in a signature couples' spa treatment performed in an overwater pavilion with glass floor panels revealing the turquoise lagoon below. The ritual includes a traditional Maldivian coconut scrub, hot stone massage, and floral bath drawn with local tropical blooms. A deeply relaxing and romantic luxury experience tailored for honeymooners.

experiences.name: Local Island Cultural Walk & Maldivian Cooking Class
experiences.description: Visit a traditional inhabited local island to experience authentic Maldivian culture, architecture, and daily life. Stroll through narrow coral-stone lanes, visit a local mosque, and then join a hands-on cooking class where you learn to prepare classic dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and freshly baked roshi flatbread using age-old recipes.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 13:00. Complete immigration and customs. Take a budget-friendly public ferry or shared speedboat transfer to your island. Check in to Aegean Bliss Resort, Maldives (Beachfront room). Freshen up and take a leisurely stroll along the beachfront to get oriented with the resort and surroundings.
day_by_day.evening: Watch your first Maldivian sunset from the beachfront. Explore the resort grounds and nearby local area. Enjoy a relaxed welcome dinner at the resort's most affordable dining option or a nearby local café.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or grab a snack at Velana International Airport
meals.lunch: Quick bite at the airport or ferry terminal — local short eats (samosas, bajiya) for under $5
meals.dinner: Resort's casual beachside restaurant — opt for the set menu or local Maldivian fish curry with rice (~$10–15)

day_by_day.notes: Book shared ferry transfers in advance to save significantly vs. private speedboats. Keep receipts for all transport for budgeting purposes. Exchange some currency or ensure you have USD (widely accepted).

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise walk along the beachfront — completely free and incredibly romantic. After sunrise, enjoy breakfast at the resort. Rent a snorkel set from the resort or a local dive shop (budget ~$5–8/day) and explore the house reef just off the beachfront — ideal for spotting colorful reef fish, sea turtles, and coral formations.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a budget group snorkeling excursion offered by local operators (~$20–30 per person) to a nearby snorkeling hotspot or sandbank. These group tours often include 2–3 snorkeling spots and are far cheaper than private charters. Relax on the sandbank and enjoy the turquoise lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and rinse off. Take an evening stroll along the beach hand-in-hand — perfect for honeymooners. Dine at a local restaurant near the resort for an authentic and affordable Maldivian meal.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — opt for the standard continental or local option (~$8–12)
meals.lunch: Pack a simple picnic or buy snacks from a local shop before the snorkeling tour
meals.dinner: Local Maldivian restaurant near the resort — mas huni (tuna salad with coconut), roshi (flatbread), and fresh fish (~$8–12 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Apply reef-safe sunscreen only — regular sunscreen is harmful to coral reefs and may be banned on some islands. Snorkeling is best in the morning when visibility is clearest.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga or meditation on the beach (free or low-cost if offered by the resort). Afterward, explore the local island on foot — visit the island's main street, local shops, and community areas. Pick up fresh tropical fruits from a local vendor for a healthy and budget-friendly snack.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby uninhabited island via a local dhoni boat trip (~$15–25 per person for group tours). Spend the afternoon swimming, snorkeling, and relaxing on a pristine private-feeling beach. Collect shells and enjoy the solitude — deeply romantic for couples.
day_by_day.evening: Return to your island by late afternoon. Freshen up and enjoy a romantic sunset from your beachfront room or the resort's beach. Dine at the resort's casual restaurant and try the catch-of-the-day grilled fish.

meals.breakfast: Fresh tropical fruits from local vendors + tea or coffee (~$3–5)
meals.lunch: Pack snacks and water for the uninhabited island trip — buy from local shops the night before
meals.dinner: Resort casual dining — grilled catch-of-the-day with salad and rice (~$12–18 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Negotiate group dhoni trips at the local harbor for the best prices. Going with a group of other tourists significantly reduces per-person costs. Bring plenty of water and sunscreen.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling at the house reef before the crowds arrive — best time to spot sea turtles and nurse sharks resting near the coral. Spend 1–1.5 hours exploring. Return for a leisurely breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the local island's cultural sites — visit the local mosque (dress modestly, cover shoulders and knees), walk through residential streets to observe authentic Maldivian life, and browse local handicraft shops for affordable souvenirs like woven mats (thundu kunaa) and lacquerwork.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a budget-friendly DIY romantic beach picnic — buy local bread, canned fish, fresh fruits, and juice from a local shop and set up on the beach at sunset. This is one of the most romantic and affordable evening options in the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Local teashop breakfast — black tea, roshi, and mas huni (~$4–6)
meals.lunch: Local café near the cultural sites — short eats and fresh juice (~$5–8)
meals.dinner: DIY beach picnic with local groceries (~$8–12 for two people)

day_by_day.notes: Always dress modestly when visiting local islands and mosques — carry a light scarf or sarong. Local teashops (sai hotels) are the most budget-friendly dining option throughout the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Join a budget group dolphin-watching cruise (~$25–35 per person) — these typically depart in the morning and offer incredible opportunities to see spinner dolphins leaping alongside the boat. One of the most magical experiences in the Maldives.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the cruise, relax on the beachfront and enjoy some free time swimming in the lagoon. Read, nap in a hammock, or simply enjoy the stunning scenery — a true luxury experience at zero cost.
day_by_day.evening: Visit the local harbor at sunset to watch fishing boats return with the day's catch. This is a great photo opportunity and a glimpse into authentic Maldivian fishing culture. Dine at a local restaurant and try freshly caught tuna prepared in traditional Maldivian style.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or local teashop (~$5–10)
meals.lunch: Light snack on the dolphin cruise boat or back at the resort (~$5–8)
meals.dinner: Local harbor-area restaurant — fresh tuna curry with rice and coconut sambol (~$8–12)

day_by_day.notes: Book dolphin watching tours through local guesthouses or operators rather than resort desks to get better prices. Morning tours generally have calmer seas and better dolphin activity.

day_by_day.morning: Take a budget public ferry to a nearby local inhabited island for a day trip (~$2–5 one way). Explore the island on foot, visit the local school area (from outside), and interact with friendly locals. This offers an authentic cultural immersion experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkel off the visited island's beach or join locals for beach volleyball. Visit the island's small market if available and buy fresh coconuts to drink (~$1 each). Explore any coral gardens accessible from the beach.
day_by_day.evening: Take the return ferry back to your home island. Freshen up and enjoy a romantic dinner at the resort, perhaps splurging slightly on a nicer set dinner to celebrate the midpoint of your honeymoon (~$20–30 per person).

meals.breakfast: Local teashop on the visited island — roshi, egg, and tea (~$4–6)
meals.lunch: Local café on the visited island — freshly cooked fish and rice plate (~$6–10)
meals.dinner: Resort set dinner or slightly upgraded meal to mark the honeymoon midpoint (~$20–30 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Check public ferry schedules in advance as they run on fixed timetables. Carry your passport or ID for inter-island travel. Be respectful of local customs on inhabited islands.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and leisure morning — sleep in and enjoy the beachfront from your room. Take a slow morning swim in the lagoon. This is your mid-trip rest day to recharge.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a budget group manta ray or whale shark snorkeling/diving excursion if seasonally available (~$30–50 per person for snorkeling). These are bucket-list experiences and worth the splurge. If not available, explore the house reef again at a relaxed pace.
day_by_day.evening: Stargaze from the beach — the Maldives has minimal light pollution and offers stunning night skies. Lie on the beach with a blanket and enjoy the Milky Way. End the evening with a simple romantic drink (fresh coconut or local juice) on the beachfront.

meals.breakfast: In-room or resort breakfast — take your time (~$8–12)
meals.lunch: Resort casual café — sandwich or light meal (~$8–12)
meals.dinner: Local restaurant — mixed seafood platter with rice and vegetables (~$10–15)

day_by_day.notes: Whale shark and manta ray sightings are seasonal — March can be a good month depending on the specific atoll. Ask local operators about current sightings. Stargazing is best after 21:00 when resort lights dim.

day_by_day.morning: Morning snorkeling session focusing on underwater photography — use a waterproof phone case or rent an underwater camera from a local dive shop (~$10–15/day). Capture memories of colorful fish, coral, and possibly sea turtles.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local fishing village and arrange to join a traditional Maldivian hand-line fishing experience with local fishermen (~$15–25 per person for group). This traditional 'handline fishing' (mas mas) is a unique cultural experience and any catch may be cooked for dinner.
day_by_day.evening: If fish was caught during the afternoon, arrange with a local restaurant to cook it for you (they may charge a small cooking fee of ~$5). Otherwise, enjoy a local restaurant dinner. Watch the sunset from the beach.

meals.breakfast: Local teashop — tea, roshi, and local short eats (~$4–6)
meals.lunch: Packed lunch from local shop or light snack before fishing (~$5–8)
meals.dinner: Local restaurant with your own catch cooked to order, or fresh grilled fish from the menu (~$8–15)

day_by_day.notes: Traditional Maldivian fishing is typically done at sunset but can be arranged in the afternoon. Negotiate prices directly with local fishermen at the harbor for the most authentic and affordable experience.

day_by_day.morning: Take a budget snorkeling trip to a coral garden known for its biodiversity — ask the resort or local operators for the best nearby spots. Focus on a slow, meditative snorkel to fully appreciate the underwater world. Bring an underwater notebook to sketch or note what you see.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort's beachfront and surrounding area on a rented bicycle (~$5–8/day) or on foot. Find a quiet spot on the beach for a private afternoon together — read, talk, or simply enjoy the sound of waves. This is perfect honeymoon downtime.
day_by_day.evening: Create a DIY romantic evening — buy candles from a local shop, arrange them on your beachfront area (if permitted by resort), and enjoy a simple but meaningful private moment. Dine at the resort's beachside option.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or local teashop (~$5–10)
meals.lunch: Fresh coconut and local snacks on the beach (~$4–6)
meals.dinner: Resort beachside casual dining — seafood pasta or grilled fish (~$12–18)

day_by_day.notes: Ask the resort if they can arrange any complimentary honeymoon touches (flower petals, welcome drink) — many resorts offer small gestures for honeymooners even at budget properties. Always ask politely!

day_by_day.morning: Early morning kayaking in the lagoon — rent a kayak from the resort or local shop (~$10–15/hour or $25–35/day). Paddle around the island, explore mangroves if accessible, and enjoy the calm morning waters. A wonderfully romantic activity for couples.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a sandbank (sandbar) via a local group boat trip (~$15–25 per person). These temporary white sand islands surrounded by turquoise water are quintessentially Maldivian. Spend 1–2 hours swimming, snorkeling, and taking photos.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and enjoy a long, relaxing shower. Spend the evening browsing local souvenir shops for affordable gifts — look for small lacquerwork items, sarongs, and locally made jewelry. Dine at a local restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Local teashop — eggs, roshi, and tea (~$4–6)
meals.lunch: Snacks and fresh coconut at the sandbank (~$3–5)
meals.dinner: Local restaurant — Maldivian garudhiya (fish broth soup) with rice and lime (~$8–12)

day_by_day.notes: Garudhiya is the most traditional Maldivian dish and a must-try. Kayaking is best in the morning before winds pick up in the afternoon. Always wear a life jacket while kayaking.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicated morning for resort relaxation — use any free resort amenities such as the beach, pool, or hammocks. This is your luxury day within a budget. Treat yourselves to a slow, indulgent morning with no schedule.
day_by_day.afternoon: If budget allows, book a budget-friendly couples' spa treatment at the resort or a local spa (~$30–60 for a 30-minute treatment per person). Many resorts offer introductory or promotional spa packages. Alternatively, enjoy a free couple's beach massage using coconut oil purchased from a local shop.
day_by_day.evening: Special romantic dinner — this is your planned splurge evening. Choose the resort's nicest dining option or a highly-rated local seafood restaurant. Order fresh lobster or grilled reef fish with a mocktail or fresh juice. Celebrate your honeymoon.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — full spread, take your time (~$10–15)
meals.lunch: Light resort café meal — salad and fresh juice (~$8–12)
meals.dinner: Special honeymoon dinner — fresh lobster or premium seafood at resort restaurant (~$30–50 per person as a one-time splurge)

day_by_day.notes: This is your designated splurge day — budget accordingly from earlier savings. Many resorts offer special honeymoon dinner setups (beach table, candles, flowers) for a small additional fee (~$20–40) — worth booking in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Final full snorkeling adventure — revisit your favorite snorkeling spot or try a new one recommended by local operators. Spend a longer session (2–3 hours) fully immersed in the underwater world as a farewell to the reef. Try to spot any marine life you haven't seen yet.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pack, organize souvenirs, and do any last-minute shopping at local stores. Visit the local market one final time for affordable last-minute gifts — dried fish products, local spices, and handmade crafts make great presents. Take final photos around the island and beachfront.
day_by_day.evening: Final sunset on the Maldivian beach — make it count. Sit together on the beach, reflect on the trip, and watch the sun dip below the horizon. Enjoy a final local dinner at your favorite restaurant from the trip.

meals.breakfast: Local teashop — a final traditional Maldivian breakfast (~$4–6)
meals.lunch: Resort casual dining or local café (~$8–12)
meals.dinner: Return to your favorite local restaurant from the trip — order your favorite dish one last time (~$10–15)

day_by_day.notes: Begin packing tonight to make the next morning smooth. Confirm transfer arrangements to the airport for Day 13. Keep some USD cash for any final tips or last-minute purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise walk on the beach — wake up early for one last Maldivian sunrise. Take photos, collect a small piece of sand in a bottle as a memento. Enjoy a final breakfast at the resort. Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort and arrange luggage storage if needed.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on departure time, take a final swim or sit by the beach before transfer. Head to the ferry terminal or speedboat dock for your transfer back to Velana International Airport. Allow ample time for check-in and security.
day_by_day.evening: Depart from Velana International Airport. Carry wonderful memories, photos, and the glow of a beautifully spent honeymoon in the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast or local teashop — make it special (~$6–10)
meals.lunch: Airport dining or snacks before departure — budget Maldivian café at the airport (~$8–15)
meals.dinner: On the flight or at your layover destination

day_by_day.notes: Tip your resort staff, boat crew, and restaurant servers if they provided great service — even small tips (1–2 USD) are greatly appreciated. Arrive at the airport at least 3 hours before international departure. Keep all receipts to tally your final budget upon return.

trip_options.title: Classic Maldives Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Malé International Airport at 13:00. Clear immigration and collect luggage. Meet the Aegean Bliss Resort transfer representative and board the resort's speedboat or seaplane transfer to the resort. Check in to your Beachfront accommodation, receive a welcome drink and resort orientation tour. Freshen up and settle into your room.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll along the beachfront at sunset to soak in your first Maldivian evening. Enjoy a relaxed welcome dinner at the resort's main restaurant overlooking the lagoon.

meals.breakfast: On the flight
meals.lunch: Light snack or meal at Malé airport during transit
meals.dinner: Welcome dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort's main beachfront restaurant — try the grilled fresh catch of the day with a glass of house wine (mid-range set menu)

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light and relaxing. Confirm all upcoming experience bookings with the resort concierge upon check-in. Ask about house reef snorkeling access and resort activity schedules.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort. Afterward, head to the house reef for a relaxed introductory snorkel session directly from the beach — spot colorful reef fish, corals, and possibly a sea turtle right off the shoreline. Rent snorkel gear from the resort's water sports center if not included.
day_by_day.afternoon: Book the 'Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari' — a guided excursion by boat to some of the most vibrant coral gardens in the atoll. Encounter manta rays, reef sharks, sea turtles, and dazzling schools of tropical fish with an expert marine guide.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and shower. Enjoy cocktails at the overwater bar as the sky turns golden. Dine at the resort's à la carte seafood restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort's main restaurant
meals.lunch: Light packed lunch or snacks provided during the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari on the boat
meals.dinner: À la carte seafood dinner at the resort — grilled lobster or tuna steak with tropical sides (mid-range pricing)

day_by_day.notes: Apply reef-safe sunscreen generously before snorkeling. The Coral Garden Safari typically runs 3–4 hours. Bring an underwater camera or rent a GoPro from the resort to capture the marine life.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a romantic in-room breakfast or a quiet table-for-two at the beachfront restaurant. Spend the morning lounging on your private beach stretch, reading, or taking a gentle swim in the crystal-clear lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in the 'Overwater Bungalow Couples Spa Ritual' — a signature couples' treatment in an overwater pavilion featuring glass floor panels revealing the ocean below. Enjoy massages, body scrubs, and aromatherapy in this intimate setting.
day_by_day.evening: Dress up for a special evening. Book the 'Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne' — sail on a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni boat with your partner, sipping champagne as the sun melts into the Indian Ocean horizon.

meals.breakfast: Romantic in-room breakfast or beachfront café — fresh tropical fruits, pastries, eggs, and coffee
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort's poolside grill — sandwiches, salads, and fresh juices
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's overwater restaurant after returning from the dhoni cruise — sushi and Asian fusion menu

day_by_day.notes: Book the Couples Spa Ritual and Sunset Dhoni Cruise in advance as slots fill up quickly. The dhoni cruise typically lasts 1.5–2 hours and departs around 5:00–5:30 PM depending on sunset time in March.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for a sunrise kayaking session around the lagoon — most resorts offer complimentary or low-cost kayak rentals. Paddle through calm turquoise waters and watch the atoll come alive at dawn. Return for a hearty breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join the resort's guided manta ray snorkeling excursion (check with concierge for scheduled trips in March — peak manta season). Alternatively, take a stand-up paddleboard lesson or try windsurfing at the water sports center.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a quiet evening on your private beach. Arrange for the resort to set up a private beach bonfire with cushions and lanterns. Order drinks from the beach butler service and stargaze together.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the main restaurant
meals.lunch: Beachside lunch — grilled fish tacos, fresh coconut, and tropical smoothies at the resort's casual beach shack
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main restaurant — Maldivian curry night or themed buffet (great value for mid-range budget)

day_by_day.notes: March is an excellent month for manta ray sightings in the Maldives as the northeast monsoon transitions. Confirm manta excursion availability and cost with the concierge. Beach bonfire setup may have a small additional fee.

day_by_day.morning: Participate in the 'Local Island Cultural Walk & Maldivian Cooking Class' excursion. Board a boat to a nearby inhabited local island, walk through traditional neighborhoods, visit the local mosque, and explore the island's daily life with a knowledgeable guide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the cultural experience with an authentic Maldivian cooking class — learn to prepare local dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya (fish broth), and roshi (flatbread) using traditional techniques and local ingredients.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Relax on the beach and enjoy a sundowner at the overwater bar. Have a quiet, early dinner and reflect on the cultural discoveries of the day.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort before departure for the excursion
meals.lunch: Traditional Maldivian lunch prepared and eaten as part of the cooking class on the local island — an authentic and memorable experience
meals.dinner: Casual dinner at the resort's poolside restaurant — wood-fired pizza or pasta (lighter, mid-range option)

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly when visiting the local island — cover shoulders and knees out of respect for local customs. Bring small gifts or buy locally made handicrafts to support the community. This excursion typically runs 5–6 hours.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a full rest and relaxation morning. Sleep in, order room service, and spend time on your private beach terrace. Read, nap in the hammock, or simply listen to the ocean.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's spa for individual treatments — choose from a Balinese massage, hot stone therapy, or a deep tissue massage. Alternatively, take a snorkeling trip to a nearby sandbank for a secluded swim in shallow, gin-clear waters.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the 'Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience' — dine in an extraordinary all-glass underwater restaurant surrounded by the living reef. Watch reef fish and sharks glide past as you enjoy a multi-course fine dining menu.

meals.breakfast: Room service breakfast — continental spread with fresh juices delivered to your terrace
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch — mezze platter, hummus, pita, and salads
meals.dinner: Multi-course dinner at the Underwater Restaurant — a truly once-in-a-lifetime dining experience (splurge-worthy; book well in advance)

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Restaurant is a premium experience — reserve at least 3–4 days in advance as it is extremely popular. Dress code is typically smart casual. This is the perfect romantic highlight of the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Mid-trip reset day. Wake up naturally, enjoy breakfast at your own pace, and spend the morning doing absolutely nothing — lie in the sun, wade in the lagoon, or read under a palm tree. Embrace the Maldivian concept of 'island time.'
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a resort-organized dolphin watching cruise — a popular afternoon activity where you follow pods of spinner dolphins playing in the waves. Bring binoculars and your camera for incredible wildlife moments.
day_by_day.evening: Return from the dolphin cruise in time for sunset. Enjoy happy hour cocktails at the overwater bar. Have dinner at the resort's main restaurant with a special table reserved near the water's edge.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely buffet breakfast — take your time and try everything on offer
meals.lunch: Light snack box or fruit platter during the dolphin watching cruise
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main restaurant — grilled barracuda or tuna with Maldivian spices and coconut rice (mid-range à la carte)

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin watching cruises typically depart in the late afternoon and last about 1.5 hours. Spinner dolphins are commonly spotted year-round in the Maldives. Bring motion sickness tablets if you are sensitive to boat movement.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling session at the house reef before the day heats up — the underwater visibility is often at its best in the early morning hours. Look for octopus, moray eels, and sleeping nurse sharks in the coral crevices.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a beginner scuba diving discovery session (resort PADI dive center) — experience the magic of breathing underwater for the first time in a controlled, safe environment with a certified instructor. Explore the house reef at 5–8 meters depth.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate the halfway point of your trip with a romantic private beach dinner arranged by the resort — a candlelit table on the sand, fairy lights, fresh flowers, and a personalized menu. A quintessential honeymoon experience.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before snorkeling — yogurt, fruit, and toast
meals.lunch: Post-dive lunch at the resort's beach grill — burgers, wraps, and fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Private beach candlelit dinner — pre-selected 3-course menu with wine pairing (arrange with concierge 48 hours in advance)

day_by_day.notes: The private beach dinner is a must-do honeymoon experience. Costs vary but are generally mid-to-high range — ask the concierge for pricing and customization options including flower arrangements and champagne add-ons.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recover with a slow morning. Enjoy breakfast together, then head to the resort's infinity pool for a lazy swim with panoramic lagoon views. Try the resort's signature cocktail menu at the swim-up bar.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on a second 'Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari' — this time explore a different reef system in the atoll. Many operators cover multiple sites in one trip, so you may encounter different marine species including eagle rays and whale sharks (seasonal).
day_by_day.evening: Sunset yoga session on the beach — check the resort's activity board for scheduled classes. Wind down with herbal tea at the spa lounge before a casual dinner.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the main restaurant
meals.lunch: Snacks and refreshments on the snorkeling boat
meals.dinner: Casual dinner at the resort's Italian-inspired restaurant — wood-fired pizza, bruschetta, and tiramisu

day_by_day.notes: Whale shark sightings are possible in March in the Maldives, particularly near South Ari Atoll. Ask your concierge about dedicated whale shark snorkeling excursions if interested — this is a bucket-list experience.

day_by_day.morning: Book a morning fishing excursion — traditional Maldivian hand-line fishing on a local dhoni boat. Try your hand at catching reef fish with the guidance of a local fisherman. A peaceful and authentic way to spend a morning on the water.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and relax. Spend the afternoon at the spa for a solo or couples' facial and body wrap treatment. Alternatively, explore the resort's boutique shops for Maldivian souvenirs and locally crafted jewelry.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a second 'Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne' — or opt for a different sunset activity such as a romantic picnic on a private sandbank arranged by the resort (additional cost applies).

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast before the fishing excursion — eggs, toast, and coffee
meals.lunch: Freshly caught fish grilled by the boat crew or back at the resort's beach grill — a truly farm-to-table (sea-to-table) experience
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's teppanyaki or Asian grill restaurant — chef's table-style cooking with fresh seafood

day_by_day.notes: Some resorts offer to cook your freshly caught fish for you — confirm this with the excursion team. The private sandbank picnic is a magical alternative to the dhoni cruise if you've already done it on Day 3.

day_by_day.morning: Adventure morning — try parasailing or jet skiing at the resort's water sports center for an adrenaline rush against the backdrop of the turquoise lagoon. Alternatively, explore the lagoon on a glass-bottom kayak to observe the reef below.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head back to the spa for the 'Overwater Bungalow Couples Spa Ritual' if you'd like a second session, or try individual treatments such as a hot lava stone massage or a traditional Maldivian coconut oil massage.
day_by_day.evening: Visit the resort's fire dancing and cultural show — many Maldivian resorts host traditional bodu beru drum performances and fire shows in the evenings. Enjoy the show with cocktails on the beach.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the main restaurant
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch — Caesar salad, club sandwich, and fresh lime soda
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main restaurant during the cultural show — buffet or set menu themed around Maldivian and Sri Lankan cuisine

day_by_day.notes: Check the resort's weekly entertainment schedule upon arrival and mark the cultural show night in your calendar. Bodu beru performances are a vibrant and authentic part of Maldivian heritage.

day_by_day.morning: Final full day — make it special. Wake up early for a sunrise walk along the beach, collecting shells and reflecting on the journey. Enjoy a slow, indulgent breakfast together.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon doing your favorite activity from the trip — whether that's snorkeling the house reef one last time, floating in the lagoon, or simply lounging on the beach with a good book. Visit the resort boutique for last-minute gifts and souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Grand farewell dinner at the resort's finest restaurant — splurge slightly on a special tasting menu or degustation experience to celebrate your honeymoon and the end of a magical trip.

meals.breakfast: Special à la carte breakfast — eggs benedict, smoked salmon, fresh tropical fruit platter, and specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Casual beach club lunch — sharing platters of mezze, grilled prawns, and tropical fruit
meals.dinner: Farewell tasting menu dinner at the resort's signature fine dining restaurant — 5-course menu with wine pairing (splurge occasion)

day_by_day.notes: Pack non-essentials the night before to avoid a rushed morning on Day 13. Confirm your checkout time, departure transfer schedule, and any outstanding charges with the resort reception this evening.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up for a final sunrise swim or a quiet walk on the beach. Enjoy a last leisurely breakfast at the resort. Complete checkout formalities and say goodbye to the resort staff.
day_by_day.afternoon: Board the resort's transfer boat or seaplane back to Malé International Airport. Allow ample time for the journey depending on the resort's distance from Malé. Browse duty-free shops at the airport for Maldivian black coral jewelry, local spices, or premium rum.
day_by_day.evening: Depart from Malé International Airport. Carry the memories of 13 unforgettable days in paradise — the turquoise lagoons, vibrant coral reefs, romantic sunsets, and the gentle rhythm of island life.

meals.breakfast: Final buffet breakfast at the resort — savor every bite
meals.lunch: Light meal at Malé airport — airport café or restaurant
meals.dinner: On the flight home

day_by_day.notes: Standard checkout time is 12:00 noon — confirm with the resort if a late checkout is available (often subject to availability and a small fee). Keep travel documents, valuables, and a change of clothes in your carry-on for the journey home. Ensure all underwater camera footage is backed up before departure.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat with your partner as the sun dips below the Indian Ocean horizon. Enjoy chilled champagne, fresh tropical fruit platters, and breathtaking 360-degree ocean views. Many resorts offer this as a private romantic excursion perfect for honeymooners seeking an intimate and unforgettable sunset experience.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore some of the world's most vibrant coral reefs teeming with sea turtles, manta rays, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish. A guided snorkeling safari takes you to multiple pristine reef sites across the atoll, with equipment provided and a marine biologist on hand to narrate the underwater wonders. Ideal for couples who love the ocean.

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience
experiences.description: Dine in an extraordinary all-glass underwater restaurant surrounded by the living reef and marine life. Enjoy a curated multi-course fine dining menu featuring fresh Maldivian seafood and international cuisine while fish, rays, and eels glide past your table. A once-in-a-lifetime romantic dinner that epitomizes Maldivian luxury.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll (Hilton Conrad Maldives area)

experiences.name: Overwater Bungalow Couples Spa Ritual
experiences.description: Indulge in a signature couples' spa treatment performed in an overwater pavilion with glass floor panels revealing the turquoise lagoon below. The ritual includes a traditional Maldivian coconut scrub, hot stone massage, and floral bath drawn with local tropical blooms. A deeply relaxing and romantic luxury experience tailored for honeymooners.

experiences.name: Local Island Cultural Walk & Maldivian Cooking Class
experiences.description: Visit a traditional inhabited local island to experience authentic Maldivian culture, architecture, and daily life. Stroll through narrow coral-stone lanes, visit a local mosque, and then join a hands-on cooking class where you learn to prepare classic dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and freshly baked roshi flatbread using age-old recipes.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight in transit. Enjoy in-flight amenities.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Malé International Airport at 13:00. Met by a dedicated Aegean Bliss Resort concierge for a seamless VIP transfer via private speedboat or seaplane to the resort. Check in to your Beachfront villa with a welcome chilled coconut drink and cold towel ritual. Unpack, freshen up, and take a leisurely stroll along your private beach stretch.
day_by_day.evening: Settle into the resort ambiance with a romantic sunset cocktail hour on your villa's private deck. Watch the Indian Ocean sky turn shades of amber and rose. Enjoy a relaxed welcome dinner at the resort's signature overwater restaurant.

meals.breakfast: In-flight meal
meals.lunch: Light refreshments during speedboat/seaplane transfer arranged by the resort
meals.dinner: Welcome dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort's signature overwater fine-dining restaurant — freshly caught seafood platter, lobster bisque, and a bottle of Moët & Chandon Champagne

day_by_day.notes: Arrival day — keep the schedule light to combat jet lag. Request early check-in through the resort concierge in advance. Confirm all upcoming experience bookings with the concierge this evening.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely breakfast in bed or on your beachfront villa terrace. Afterward, take a guided house reef snorkeling session directly from the beach — discover colorful parrotfish, clownfish, and sea turtles in the calm morning waters when visibility is at its best.
day_by_day.afternoon: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari — board a private resort boat to explore some of the world's most vibrant coral reefs teeming with sea turtles, manta rays, and reef sharks. A professional marine biologist guide accompanies you to narrate the underwater ecosystem. Return by 16:00 for a refreshing freshwater rinse and poolside relaxation.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — sail on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat as the sun dips below the Indian Ocean horizon. Sip chilled Champagne and enjoy a curated canapé spread while watching the sky ignite with color.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast butler service — tropical fruit platters, eggs Benedict, freshly squeezed juices, and Maldivian roshi flatbread with tuna curry
meals.lunch: Beachside grill lunch at the resort's casual beach shack — grilled barracuda tacos, prawn skewers, and fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Return from dhoni cruise and dine at the resort's à la carte restaurant — seared yellowfin tuna, truffle risotto, and a curated wine pairing menu

day_by_day.notes: Book the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari and Dhoni Cruise through the concierge the previous evening. Apply reef-safe sunscreen only — the resort provides complimentary eco-friendly SPF. Best snorkeling visibility is typically 07:00–11:00.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the day with a sunrise yoga session on the beach or overwater deck — the resort's in-house wellness instructor leads a private couples' session. Follow with a nourishing spa breakfast at the wellness pavilion.
day_by_day.afternoon: Overwater Bungalow Couples Spa Ritual — indulge in a signature couples' spa treatment in an overwater pavilion with glass floor panels revealing the turquoise lagoon below. Enjoy a 90-minute treatment including a Maldivian coconut scrub, warm stone massage, and flower petal bath. Spend the remaining afternoon floating in your villa's private plunge pool.
day_by_day.evening: Stargazing experience on the sandbank — the resort arranges a private setup with telescopes, a stargazing guide, and a chilled Champagne bucket on a secluded sandbank accessible by short boat ride.

meals.breakfast: Wellness breakfast at the spa pavilion — acai bowls, chia pudding, green smoothies, and herbal teas
meals.lunch: In-villa dining — club sandwiches, lobster salad, and sparkling water served by your villa host
meals.dinner: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience — dine surrounded by the living reef and marine life in the all-glass underwater restaurant. Seven-course tasting menu with wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: The Couples Spa Ritual should be pre-booked at least 48 hours in advance. The Underwater Restaurant is one of the resort's most exclusive experiences — request a table near the central glass dome for the most immersive view. Sandbank stargazing is weather-dependent; the concierge will advise on conditions.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a slow morning. Take a private kayaking or stand-up paddleboarding session in the calm lagoon waters surrounding the resort. The glassy morning water makes for perfect paddling conditions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Local Island Cultural Walk & Maldivian Cooking Class — take a resort speedboat to a nearby traditional inhabited island. Explore local architecture, mosques, and fishing villages with a knowledgeable guide. Then participate in a hands-on Maldivian cooking class — learn to prepare mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and hedhikaa (local snacks).
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by 17:30. Enjoy a private romantic beach dinner setup — white linen table for two on the sand, torchlit ambiance, a personalized menu crafted by the resort's executive chef, and a dedicated butler for the evening.

meals.breakfast: Overwater restaurant buffet breakfast — international and Maldivian spreads including fresh tropical fruits, live egg station, pastries, and Maldivian fish curry
meals.lunch: Lunch on the local island as part of the cooking class — enjoy the dishes you prepared with fresh coconut toddy or tropical juice
meals.dinner: Private torchlit beach dinner — five-course personalized menu featuring lobster thermidor, pan-seared snapper, and a decadent chocolate fondant dessert with Champagne

day_by_day.notes: The Local Island Cultural Walk requires modest dress — cover shoulders and knees when visiting the mosque area. The resort provides wraps if needed. Pre-arrange the private beach dinner setup through your concierge at least 24 hours in advance and communicate any dietary preferences.

day_by_day.morning: Guided dolphin watching excursion — depart at 06:30 by resort speedboat to seek spinner dolphins in their natural habitat in the open ocean. The early morning is the best time to spot them leaping alongside the boat.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return by 09:30 for a late breakfast. Spend the afternoon on a private sandbank picnic — the resort arranges a secluded white sandbank setup with sun loungers, a parasol, chilled Champagne, fresh fruit, and seafood canapés. Snorkel the surrounding waters at your own pace.
day_by_day.evening: Relaxed evening at the resort. Visit the overwater bar for handcrafted cocktails and live acoustic music. Dine at the resort's Asian fusion restaurant for a change of cuisine.

meals.breakfast: Late breakfast at the overwater restaurant upon return from dolphin watching — eggs your way, smoked salmon bagels, and freshly brewed coffee
meals.lunch: Private sandbank picnic — chilled seafood platter, gourmet sandwiches, tropical fruit skewers, and sparkling rosé
meals.dinner: Asian fusion restaurant at the resort — wagyu beef dumplings, miso-glazed black cod, jasmine rice, and yuzu sorbet for dessert

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin sightings are highly likely but not guaranteed — the marine team will advise on the best route based on recent activity. Sandbank picnics are a signature Maldives experience; request a personalized message in the sand (e.g., names or anniversary date) through the concierge for a romantic touch.

day_by_day.morning: Indulge in a full morning of leisure — sleep in, enjoy in-villa breakfast, and spend time in your private beachfront space. Optional: guided meditation session on the beach at 08:00 with the resort's wellness instructor.
day_by_day.afternoon: Big game fishing excursion — join a private chartered fishing boat with an experienced local captain and crew. Try your hand at deep-sea fishing for wahoo, mahi-mahi, or sailfish. Any catch can be prepared by the resort's chef for your dinner.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate your catch (or the adventure) with a chef's table experience — dine at the resort kitchen's private chef's table, where the executive chef prepares a bespoke multi-course meal using the day's freshest local ingredients in front of you.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — continental spread with pastries, cold cuts, cheeses, and a Maldivian fish curry side
meals.lunch: Light bento lunch box prepared by the resort and enjoyed aboard the fishing boat — sushi rolls, sandwiches, and chilled drinks
meals.dinner: Chef's table experience — bespoke five-course tasting menu featuring the day's catch prepared to your preference, paired with sommelier-selected wines

day_by_day.notes: Deep-sea fishing charters are typically 4–5 hours. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and light layers — open ocean can be breezier. Confirm the chef's table booking with the concierge at least 48 hours in advance as it accommodates a maximum of two guests.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint rest day — take a slow morning to recharge. Enjoy a lengthy breakfast, lounge by the infinity pool, and read in your villa's hammock over the water. Optional: 30-minute resort island walk to explore the lush tropical gardens and resident bird life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari (second session, different reef site) — the resort's marine team takes you to a new location known for large manta ray aggregations and vibrant hard coral formations. Afternoon light creates spectacular underwater photography conditions.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic in-villa dining experience — the resort sets up an intimate candlelit dinner on your beachfront terrace with a personalized menu, rose petal décor, and a dedicated butler. Toast the week with a premium bottle of vintage Champagne.

meals.breakfast: Extended resort buffet breakfast — spend 90 minutes grazing through international and Maldivian offerings with freshly made smoothies
meals.lunch: Poolside light lunch — Caesar salad, club sandwich, and tropical fruit platter with iced hibiscus tea
meals.dinner: In-villa romantic terrace dinner — surf and turf (grilled lobster tail and Wagyu beef tenderloin), truffle mashed potatoes, and a molten lava cake with vanilla bean ice cream

day_by_day.notes: Day 7 is intentionally paced as a rest and reflection day at the midpoint of the trip. Use this evening to reconnect and celebrate the journey so far. The concierge can arrange in-villa rose arrangements, personalized notes, or a surprise element for the romantic dinner.

day_by_day.morning: Private sunrise snorkeling session — depart at 06:00 with a resort guide to catch the magical early morning light underwater. Marine life is most active at dawn. Reef sharks and eagle rays are commonly spotted at this hour.
day_by_day.afternoon: Overwater Bungalow Couples Spa Ritual (second session with different treatments) — choose from a Javanese lulur ritual, hot volcanic stone therapy, or a deep-tissue aromatherapy massage. Spend post-treatment time relaxing on the spa's overwater deck.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne (second evening edition) — experience the dhoni cruise again, this time with a curated cheese and charcuterie board alongside your Champagne as the sky turns deep crimson.

meals.breakfast: Post-snorkeling breakfast at the overwater restaurant — smashed avocado toast, poached eggs, fresh juices, and a smoothie bowl
meals.lunch: In-villa lunch — seared tuna Niçoise salad, sourdough bread, and sparkling water with citrus
meals.dinner: Resort's premium seafood grill restaurant — whole grilled lobster, tiger prawns, and a decadent crème brûlée for dessert paired with a crisp Chablis

day_by_day.notes: The sunrise snorkeling session requires a 05:30 wake-up — arrange an early morning butler wake-up call and a pre-departure light snack the night before. The Dhoni Cruise on this evening can be customized with floating floral arrangements and a personalized keepsake from the crew.

day_by_day.morning: Seaplane scenic flight experience — take a 20–30 minute seaplane joyride over the Maldivian atolls for breathtaking aerial views of the turquoise lagoons, coral reefs, and scattered islands. Best photography opportunity of the trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and spend the afternoon on a private glass-bottom boat tour of the house reef — observe the vibrant marine life below without getting wet. Ideal for a relaxed, post-flight afternoon. Follow with poolside cocktails and light reading.
day_by_day.evening: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience (second visit, different menu) — return to the all-glass underwater restaurant for a specially curated romantic dinner. Request the private corner table with panoramic reef views.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the seaplane — fresh fruit, yogurt parfait, and espresso
meals.lunch: Beach club lunch — wood-fired pizza, grilled vegetables, and a chilled glass of rosé
meals.dinner: Underwater Restaurant — chef's special seven-course degustation menu with live reef views, paired with a premium wine selection curated by the sommelier

day_by_day.notes: Seaplane scenic flights are subject to weather and visibility — the resort will advise on the best window. Bring a camera with a wide-angle lens for aerial photography. The glass-bottom boat tour is a relaxing complement to the more active snorkeling days and is suitable even if you're feeling tired.

day_by_day.morning: Local Island Cultural Walk & Maldivian Cooking Class (revisit with a different island) — explore a second traditional island with a different cultural character. Visit a local school, artisan workshops, and the island's Friday mosque. Learn about traditional Maldivian boat-building (dhoni craftsmanship).
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort by 13:00. Afternoon at leisure — explore the resort's boutique for keepsakes and locally crafted jewelry. Enjoy a private couple's photo session on the beach with the resort's in-house photographer during the golden hour (16:30–17:30).
day_by_day.evening: Relaxed evening at the resort's overwater bar — enjoy handcrafted cocktails with live traditional Maldivian bodu beru drumming performance. Dine at the resort's Italian-Mediterranean restaurant.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — full Maldivian spread with mas huni, roshi, fresh papaya, and ginger tea
meals.lunch: Late lunch at the resort's casual beach grill upon return — fish burgers, sweet potato fries, and tropical mocktails
meals.dinner: Italian-Mediterranean restaurant at the resort — burrata with heirloom tomatoes, hand-rolled lobster linguine, and tiramisu with a glass of Barolo

day_by_day.notes: The in-house photographer session during golden hour is a highlight for honeymoon couples — book in advance and share any specific shot preferences (e.g., underwater shots with snorkel gear, sunset portraits, villa interior). Prints and a digital gallery are typically delivered within 24–48 hours.

day_by_day.morning: Full morning of wellness — begin with a 60-minute private yoga and breathwork session at the beach pavilion, followed by a 45-minute sound healing meditation. Spend the rest of the morning at the resort's infinity pool with fresh juices.
day_by_day.afternoon: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari (final session, premium reef site) — the resort's marine biologist takes you to the most biodiverse reef site in the area, known for whale shark sightings during certain seasons. Bring an underwater camera for this one.
day_by_day.evening: Surprise romantic experience arranged by the concierge — a floating breakfast setup in your villa's plunge pool transformed into a candlelit evening float with rose petals, floating candles, and a dessert table. Alternatively, a private fire dancer and traditional music performance on your beachfront.

meals.breakfast: Wellness breakfast — green detox smoothie, overnight oats, poached eggs on rye, and herbal infusions
meals.lunch: Overwater restaurant light lunch — sashimi platter, edamame, miso soup, and Japanese green tea
meals.dinner: In-villa plunge pool romantic setup — customized dessert and Champagne table, followed by a room service fine-dining order of your choice from the full resort menu

day_by_day.notes: Whale shark sightings are seasonal and location-dependent — the marine team will provide realistic expectations. Regardless, this reef site offers exceptional marine biodiversity. Coordinate the evening surprise with the concierge two days in advance and keep it a secret from your partner for maximum impact.

day_by_day.morning: Final full day — begin with a slow, indulgent morning. Order an elaborate in-villa breakfast and spend the morning swimming in the lagoon, snorkeling the house reef one last time, and simply soaking in the paradise surroundings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne (final edition — extended route) — book the extended 3-hour version of the dhoni cruise visiting a nearby uninhabited island for a short beach walk, followed by the sunset sail back with Champagne, fresh Maldivian sweets, and a keepsake letter from the captain.
day_by_day.evening: Grand farewell dinner — the resort's executive chef prepares a bespoke farewell tasting menu at the overwater fine-dining restaurant. A personalized dessert with your names and travel dates is presented as a keepsake. Toast the trip with a premium vintage Champagne.

meals.breakfast: Ultimate in-villa breakfast extravaganza — full spread of Maldivian, continental, and Asian breakfast items, fresh tropical fruit tower, artisan pastries, and a Champagne mimosa
meals.lunch: Light beach lunch — chilled gazpacho, prawn cocktail, and a sparkling water with mint
meals.dinner: Grand farewell tasting menu at the overwater fine-dining restaurant — eight-course bespoke menu with premium wine pairing, personalized dessert, and a resort keepsake gift

day_by_day.notes: Use the morning to collect any items from the resort boutique, settle the villa account, and request a luggage packing service if available. Ask the concierge to arrange a personalized farewell gift — many luxury Maldivian resorts offer a bottle of resort-branded sand and seashell keepsakes. Confirm departure logistics for the following morning.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on the beachfront — wake early for one last sunrise from your villa terrace with a room service coffee and pastry. Take a final swim in the lagoon and say goodbye to the house reef. Complete check-out formalities with the resort concierge.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private VIP speedboat or seaplane transfer back to Malé International Airport, accompanied by the resort's dedicated departure concierge. Arrive at the airport with ample time for departure. Enjoy the business or first-class lounge facilities before boarding.
day_by_day.evening: Departure flight — carry the memories of 13 extraordinary days in paradise.

meals.breakfast: Early in-villa farewell breakfast — light and energizing: fresh fruit, yogurt, croissants, and coffee or tea
meals.lunch: Airport lounge dining or in-flight meal
meals.dinner: In-flight dining

day_by_day.notes: Check-out time is typically 12:00 — request a late check-out (14:00) through the concierge if your transfer allows. The resort will store luggage and offer use of a day-use room or the spa facilities until departure. Ensure all underwater camera memory cards, souvenirs, and resort photography packages are securely packed. Leave a review for the resort and tip the villa host and concierge team who made the trip exceptional.
